'''David Deveau Deveau's Dark Side''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Deveau]]
* '''Published:''' May 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Deveau's Dark Side
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Deveau's Dark Side Deveau DS 1997.txt |Download]]
